fields.name: fire_resistance_rating
fields.rationale: The product is described as 'A1 Non Combustible (EN13501-1)', indicating its fire resistance rating, which is crucial for categorizing insulation materials based on safety standards.
evidence: SUPALUX® is an A1 Non Combustible (EN13501-1) fire-protective calcium silicate board

fields.name: moisture_resistance
fields.rationale: The product is explicitly stated to be resistant to moisture, which is a key property for insulation materials used in damp or humid conditions.
evidence: SUPALUX® is resistant to the effects of moisture and will not physically deteriorate when used in damp or humid conditions.

fields.name: installation_location
fields.rationale: The EPD specifies that the product is produced in China and installed in Europe, which is important for understanding the geographical applicability and logistics of the product.
evidence: Scope: This EPD is representative and relevant for SUPALUX® boards produced by ETEX in Guangzhou (China) and installed in Europe.
